title: WPMS/1434/2017 of Sanjeev Kumar Vs Secretary Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (M/S) No. 1434 of 2017
Sanjeev Kumar .........Petitioner
 Versus
Secretary, Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority
 ........Respondent
Present:- Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate for the respondent.
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
 The petitioner has filed the present writ petition before
this Court challenging the validity of the order dated 09.06.2017, by
which the Secretary, Mussoorie Dehradun Development Authority (in
short "MDDA") has come to the conclusion that the construction made
by the petitioner is unauthorized, and consequently the petitioner has
been ordered to demolish the said construction at his own expenses.
2. Earlier, the petitioner had received a notice, which was
challenged by the petitioner before this Court in earlier round of
litigation being WPMS No. 1083 of 2017 on ground that the
construction is compoundable and his application for compounding is
pending before the MDDA. The writ petition was disposed of by this
Court vide judgment and order dated 05.05.2017. The relevant portion
of the said judgment reads as under:-
"Writ petition is disposed of at the admission stage
with the direction to the Secretary, M.D.D.A, Dehradun to
take a decision on the compounding application of the
petitioner within two weeks from today, in accordance
with law.
For a period of two weeks, ceiling of the property in
question shall be kept in abeyance."
3. Now the learned counsel for the respondent i.e. MDDA,
has apprised this Court that the construction in question is not
compoundable and the application of the petitioner for compounding

2
has been dismissed and the petitioner has been ordered to demolish the
construction vide order dated 09.06.2017.
4. In view thereof, no interference is called for by this Court.
The writ petition stands dismissed. Let appropriate action be taken by
the MDDA in accordance with law.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 16.06.2017
Ankit/
